linearization: The coordinator RLock serializes takeover's durable fence and external control transition with command/review/shutdown and every transition that changes automatic eligibility.

takeover_behavior.durable_order: current manager/control/process checks, then durable takeover_requested, then external request
takeover_behavior.unknown_command: CommandState before/after equal; one original send and zero replay
takeover_behavior.review_first: one review completes before the durable takeover fence; later tick held
takeover_behavior.takeover_first: durable fence precedes waiting tick; pause dispatch, review and send counts are zero
takeover_behavior.external_failure: durable takeover fence remains set and the reentrant path terminates within three seconds
